title: AY2026-2027 Calendaring Summit
description: You're invited to join Campus Life on Thursday May 14 from 10:00am-2:00pm in the Honors College to collaborate in calendaring our AY26-27 student programming and events. We will dialogue, lunch, and plot out our anticipated initiatives. Please RSVP.

title: CMTA Coming Home Celebration: The Story Continues...
venue: Judy Sturgis Hill Building - Legacy Theatre
description: CMTA has always been more than a School. It's where storytellers, communicators, and creators first learned to find their voice and make meaning. We hope you'll come home to CMTA on May 16, share your story, and celebrate with your extended family!
